# goslop text fixture — constant/module argv (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-88-constant-argv-safe.py
---
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

KEY_FILE = Path.home() / ".config/app/secret.key"


def encrypt(token: str) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(
        [
            "openssl",
            "enc",
            "-aes-256-cbc",
            "-pass",
            "file:" + str(KEY_FILE),
            "-base64",
        ],
        input=token.encode(),
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
    ).stdout.decode()
